title: Dynamo v1.6.0-deepseek-v4.1-flash-dev.2
text:
Release Notes
Dynamo v1.6.0-deepseek-v4.1-flash-dev.2 is an experimental snapshot build with early DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash support on the Dynamo vLLM backend. It is not recommended for production and is not a QA-gated release. APIs, behavior, and defaults may change before stable support. Use it for evaluation, testing, and early feedback only.
Summary
Dynamo v1.6.0-deepseek-v4.1-flash-dev.2 adds serving for deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on Dynamo vLLM. The published container is built from multi-arch vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0 (CUDA 13.0.2, source db9527a46873454610df6dbedf79a36d6bf1a7f6) and carries NIXL transfer patches that advance the connector protocol to 14. vLLM Omni is disabled in this image (#15532).
Kubernetes recipes cover aggregated and 1P1D disaggregated vLLM profiles on B200, GB200, and H200. B200 and GB200 use eight GPUs with MXFP4 sparse-indexer KV, sparse-indexer logits, and deep_gemm_mega_moe. H200 uses 16 GPUs for aggregated serving or eight for disaggregated serving, with CUTLASS MoE. Every vLLM profile uses expert parallelism, expert load balancing, KV-aware routing, and DSpark with three draft tokens. Disaggregated profiles transfer KV over NIXL/UCX. The shared model-cache download pins Hugging Face revision dba1be0a40aa45a94ad051997016db3960a90277, and measured agentic results ship with the recipes (#15941).

About DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is a Mixture-of-Experts checkpoint from DeepSeek (deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash). This preview serves it through Dynamo's vLLM backend, with aggregated or 1P1D disaggregated workers, DSpark speculative decoding, and KV-aware routing on B200, GB200, and H200.
Full Changelog
vLLM Backend
Patched vLLM 0.31.0 runtime: Pins the CUDA 13 vLLM runtime to multi-arch v0.31.0 and applies the NIXL telemetry, region-dedup, and piecewise-prefix patches so workers in this image use connector protocol 14. vLLM Omni stays disabled (#15532).
Recipes
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash vLLM recipes: Added aggregated and 1P1D disaggregated Kustomize profiles for B200 (8 GPU), GB200 (8 GPU), and H200 (16 GPU aggregated, 8 GPU disaggregated). Profiles use expert parallelism, EPLB, KV-aware routing, and DSpark-3. Disaggregated KV transfer uses NIXL/UCX (InfiniBand on B200 and H200; one NVLink clique on GB200). Includes the shared model-cache download, agentic benchmark job, and deployment guide (recipe folder, docs, benchmarks) (#15941).
Getting Started
Deployment is Kubernetes-based (Dynamo Platform + DynamoGraphDeployment). Full steps — namespace, model-cache PVC, Hugging Face download job pinned to revision dba1be0a40aa45a94ad051997016db3960a90277, Kustomize render, DGD apply, and a /v1/chat/completions smoke test — are in the recipe docs. Recipes expect an nvcr.io image-pull secret, a Hugging Face token secret named hf-token-secret, and Kustomize v5.8.1. GB200 workers schedule on ARM64 nodes; B200 and H200 workers schedule on AMD64 nodes.
Known Issues / Limitations
This is a branch-specific snapshot build, not a QA-gated stable release.
Workers in this runtime image use NIXL connector protocol 14. CUDA dev and local-dev images stay on protocol 13; do not mix them in one KV transfer.
GB200 disaggregated workers must share one NVLink clique.
H200 disaggregated serving places prefill and decode on separate RDMA-capable nodes and selects NICs from the rdma/ib device plugin. Do not set a static UCX_NET_DEVICES value.
B200 and GB200 disaggregated recipes still need the cluster's RDMA device and interface settings in the Kustomization.
SGLang profiles in recipes/deepseek-v4.1-flash still use sglang-runtime:1.6.0-deepseek-v4.1-flash-dev.1. They are not served by this vLLM image.
